methodology: Articles sourced from Virginia-specific RSS feeds and Google News RSS, filtered for AI/technology/workforce relevance, then assessed by Claude against the scenario framework. Each article is tagged with the region it most affects and the scenario it signals toward.

signals.title: Tech Briefs: Virginia Tech researchers’ AI model is meant to manage water use
signals.signal_reading: Virginia Tech's water management AI model combined with #AppalachiaBuiltThis hands-on community build night in Abingdon signals deep, distributed capability development reaching historically underserved regions through educational institutions and grassroots tech-building culture.

signals.title: Norfolk native brings free AI workshops to Hampton Roads to close the technology gap - WTKR
signals.signal_reading: Free AI workshops led by a Norfolk native to 'close the technology gap' represents peer-to-peer knowledge distribution creating broad AI fluency outside the NoVA corridor, though depth sustainability depends on follow-through infrastructure.

signals.title: Roanoke College launches WorkAI Lab to prepare leaders for new era of technology - Roanoke College
signals.signal_reading: Roanoke College's WorkAI Lab creates institutional depth in workforce AI preparation, but as a single college initiative in a rural area, it risks reinforcing concentrated excellence rather than regional distribution unless it develops broader ecosystem partnerships.

signals.title: ‘Shaping our future’: Company powering AI data centers invests $50+ million in Henrico, adding 200 jobs - WWBT
signals.signal_reading: A $50M+ investment adding 200 jobs in Henrico for AI data center infrastructure deepens Richmond's position as a secondary hub, but infrastructure jobs don't necessarily translate to distributed AI capability development across Virginia's rural regions.

signals.title: New Jersey, Virginia Can Lead the Nation By Building ‘AI Resilience Cohorts’ to Develop Early-Career, State Talent Pipelines - Federation of American Scientists
signals.signal_reading: The proposed 'AI Resilience Cohorts' for early-career state talent pipelines would intentionally distribute deep AI capability development across Virginia through structured peer networks, directly targeting the Build It Yourself scenario if implemented beyond metro centers.
